Samira Khan: Kickoff for Meridian Retail onboarding — start Mon 2026-05-04. Need final stakeholder list, 14-day success metrics, owners for infra/enablement/billing, and any renewal risk flags. @Ethan Brooks @Maya Singh @Luis Ortega

Ethan Brooks: From intake: Priya V. (Product), Jorge M. (Infra), and Tara L. (Data). Finance contact pending. CSM noted a procurement hold potentially in 40 days ":warning:"

Maya Singh: I can run enablement (30-45m). Will cover console, deployment patterns, and error triage. Will post agenda and invite after confirming preferred time (mornings preferred).

Luis Ortega: I'll own technical setup: env, API keys, test data ingest, and smoke tests. Need network owner for on-prem firewall rules. Will share pre-onboard checklist tomorrow.

Samira Khan: Draft 14-day success: (1) staging smoke with median gen latency <200ms; (2) 8-10 core prompts pass quality gate (<=5% failure); (3) 3 engineers with console access; (4) billing estimate and quota sanity-check completed. Additions?

Ethan Brooks: Add model pin to rw-v1.3 for rollout stability and a PII/data handling signoff for prompt sets. Also track adoption signal: % of calls from prod candidates after day 14.

Maya Singh: I'll collect enablement feedback with a 3-question form and log results in the playbook.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: "Meridian - Enablement" Tue 2026-05-05 16:00 UTC  https://calendar.example/evt/55555

Samira Khan: Who will own the 14-day health summary (KPIs, blockers, renewal flags)? Need a one-pager + 15-min sync on day 14.

Luis Ortega: I'll draft the health summary (latency p50/p95, 5xx rate, quality pass %, integration blockers) and share by day 12. Will also add an SLA exceptions note for initial throughput limits.

Samira Khan: Great — Ill update the onboarding playbook with owners and add the procurement hold to Renewal Signals with mitigation steps (exec intro + monthly usage highlights).
